collective_memory.summary: Compressed rounds 1-10: Collectors split between early hype buyers chasing numbers and critics who cited faceless prepay risk and the tin-and-plant mismatch; fabric and size questions stayed unanswered and sentiment hovered mildly positive-to-mixed.

Compressed rounds 11-20: Collectors celebrated unboxings and tin quality while critics said a single batch does not erase prepay risk; first dead-seed reports cooled some enthusiasm, but sprout posts kept sentiment positive for buyers.
